mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, project_id, name, model_version_id, dataset_version_id, image, command, resource_spec::text AS resource_spec, hyperparameters::text AS hyperparameters, container_spec::text AS container_spec, status, priority, assigned_node_id, progress, error_message, started_at, completed_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_task (tenant_id, project_id, name, model_version_id, dataset_version_id, image, command, resource_spec, hyperparameters, container_spec, status, priority, assigned_node_id, progress, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{name}, #{modelVersionId}, #{datasetVersionId}, #{image}, #{command}, CAST(#{resourceSpec} AS JSONB)NULL, CAST(#{hyperparameters} AS JSONB)NULL, CAST(#{containerSpec} AS JSONB)NULL, COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending'), COALESCE(#{priority}, 0), #{assignedNodeId}, COALESCE(#{progress}, 0), #{createdBy})
mapper.update:
UPDATE training_task
status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, assigned_node_id = #{assignedNodeId}, started_at = #{startedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')
UPDATE training_task SET priority = #{priority}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE training_task SET status = 'queued', progress = 0, error_message = NULL, assigned_node_id = NULL, started_at = NULL, completed_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status NOT IN ('queued', 'running')
